ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_margin
ir.intuition: Repaired to avoid high similarity with existing KL divergence loss by switching to a margin-based pairwise log-sigmoid loss on advantage differences. This loss encourages the model to assign higher probability to the preferred choice by maximizing log-sigmoid of the difference in log probabilities weighted by the advantage gap. It passes static and dynamic checks, uses only allowed operators, and relies on the advantage_gap signal for preference alignment.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = advantage_w - advantage_l
loss = -logsigmoid((log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * margin)
weighted_loss = weight * loss
final_loss = mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']
    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)

    margin = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)
    logit_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_logit = ops.mul(logit_diff, margin)
    per_pair_loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_logit))

    if weight is not None:
        per_pair_loss = ops.mul(per_pair_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(per_pair_loss)
